strategy: Technology Leadership + AI/Cloud Transformation + Telecom/Enterprise + Strategic Customer + Strategy-to-Execution
principles: Prioritize recurring gaps with measurable 30-90 day screening value.
Do not attempt to retrofit structural history such as years in a major consulting firm or work authorization.
Do not infer causality from a single rejection; require multiple comparable outcomes.
Never invent metrics; use only values or ranges defensible in interview.
Do not redirect the profile toward pure hands-on AI/ML engineering unless market outcomes justify it.

priority_gaps.gap: Quantified strategic-account, commercial and transformation impact evidence
market_evidence: Telefónica Account Executive Grandes Clientes measures revenue, new sales and customer satisfaction.
Telefónica Account Specialist Data/AI expects identification, construction and closure of high-value Data/AI opportunities.
Telefónica/Wayra Innovation Project Manager and AI Enabler requires project profitability, financial follow-up and tangible business impact.
Capgemini Senior Product Owner - Agentic AI requires measurable business outcomes and product success metrics.
Accenture Data & AI Strategy Senior Manager requires value cases, investment profiles, roadmaps and measurable business outcomes.
priority_gaps.action_today: Reconstruct one CANTV achievement: program/account scope, baseline, responsibility, stakeholders, team, budget/contract only where evidenced, KPI and measured result. Mark unknowns explicitly; do not estimate.
priority_gaps.target_evidence: 8-12 defensible quantified achievements across Nokia/Telefónica, CANTV and current AI/cloud work.
priority_gaps.selection_probability_effect: No numeric uplift assigned yet; comparable outcome evidence remains insufficient.

priority_gaps.gap: Production-style Agentic AI / GenAI product delivery evidence
market_evidence: Capgemini Senior Product Owner - Agentic AI requires proven GenAI/Agentic AI delivery from discovery through deployment plus RAG, agents, tool calling, evaluation, guardrails, APIs and cloud.

Capgemini Senior Agentic AI Solution Specialist in Madrid requires Python, AI frameworks, RAG and cloud delivery, reinforcing the value of practical evidence even though it is not a primary target role.
Accenture Data & AI Strategy Senior Manager connects AI platform blueprints, operationalization, AI-first products and measurable outcomes.
priority_gaps.action_today: Advance one real S2A2Dynamics portfolio case: business problem, architecture, API contract, Python contribution where real, agent/RAG workflow if applicable, deployment evidence, evaluation/guardrails, observability and measured adoption/value. Do not claim production scale that is not demonstrated.
priority_gaps.selection_probability_effect: Expected to materially improve credibility for AI Product/Program and AI Transformation roles; no defensible numeric delta yet.

market_evidence: Telefónica Data/AI values Data Governance and AI Governance credentials and cloud/data architecture knowledge.
GE Vernova Governance & Responsible AI Leader prefers familiarity with EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001.
Capgemini Agentic AI roles require cloud fluency across Azure/AWS/GCP.
plan: P0 Google Cloud Generative AI Leader
P2 AWS Solutions Architect Associate while cloud opportunity density persists

priority_gaps.action_today: Continue Google Cloud Generative AI Leader preparation and record completed modules only; keep Professional Cloud Architect next and AWS Solutions Architect Associate after Google P0/P1 unless an interview accelerates it.
priority_gaps.selection_probability_effect: No numeric uplift assigned until comparable outcome evidence exists.

priority_gaps.gap: Long formal consulting tenure for selected strategy-firm roles
market_evidence: Selected strategy roles impose explicit consulting-tenure screens.
Accenture Data & AI Strategy Senior Manager is more flexible because relevant industry/functional experience can substitute for consulting experience.
priority_gaps.action_today: Do not manufacture consulting history. Reframe genuine advisory/transformation work as consulting-style evidence and favor roles explicitly accepting relevant industry/functional experience.

market_evidence: Telefónica Account Executive requires explicit commercial targets and portfolio ownership.
Telefónica Data/AI requires complex B2B opportunity closure and consultative selling.
priority_gaps.action_today: Extract defensible Nokia/Telefónica evidence of quota/target ownership, pipeline creation, complex solution selling and negotiated commercial value. Do not claim cloud sales where it did not exist.

next_tier.action: TOGAF Foundation + Practitioner after cloud P0/P1.
AWS Solutions Architect Associate after Google P0/P1 unless an AWS interview accelerates the need.
Docker -> Kubernetes -> GKE/EKS deployment evidence; certify only if target-role frequency continues rising.

outcome_calibration.note: Accenture Principal Agentic AI Transformation Lead - Hands On remains one weak calibration signal for very hands-on Principal Agentic AI roles only. It must not be generalized to product-led Agentic AI, strategic-account or broader transformation roles.
